title: Plaza Quince Martires curved grass enclosures, integrated benches and lanterns
credit: Plaza detail adapted from Patrick Roque and Ralff Nestor Nacor / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); estimated geometry; layout: project-owner atlas annotations (2026-09-30)

sources.title: OpenStreetMap: Plaza Quince Martires
sources.note: Plaza boundary and monument anchor. No Google imagery was traced.

sources.title: Patrick Roque: Quince Martires Plaza, 15 April 2023
sources.note: CC BY-SA 4.0. Independent ground photograph of low curved stone seating, tree islands, open promenade and three-head lanterns. Fixture placement follows the separately credited project-owner annotation; dimensions are illustrative estimates, not a survey or dated reconstruction.

sources.title: Ralff Nestor Nacor: Plaza Quince Martires, 5 August 2023
sources.note: CC BY-SA 4.0. Independent ground photograph of clipped shrubs inside raised gardens, continuous gray stone edges with rounded ends, multi-head lanterns and the stepped circular monument apron. Estimated geometry; no flower colors or species inferred.

sources.title: Project owner: annotated Quince Martires Plaza atlas view, 30 September 2026
sources.note: Placement corrections from the owner's 1168 x 1442 annotated atlas image: nine red tree centers, five magenta open stone benches, violet flagpole position, and removal of the two blue-crossed benches only. Calibrated to the OSM plaza boundary and monument; positions and 5 m tree crown diameters remain illustrative, not surveyed dimensions.

sources.title: Project owner: curved enclosure and bench annotation, 30 September 2026
sources.note: Five integrated grass-filled enclosures: the Arana Street end and four side beds. Red lines indicate rounded enclosure ends; yellow lines indicate the promenade-facing bench sections. Illustrative curves fitted to the owner-provided atlas annotation and existing OSM boundary, with 0.3 m stone rims, 0.8 m seating and 0.45 m height. Supersedes the five detached benches; retains tree centers, crown sizes and all six lamps. Grass and existing shrub clusters follow the owner-selected layout; only shrubs outside the revised beds are repositioned.

sources.title: Project owner: supplied curved stone planter reference photograph, 30 September 2026
sources.note: Appearance reference for flowing stone edges and grass-filled enclosures only; not used to derive geographic positions or measured dimensions. Photographer and license not established; image is not distributed with the city pack. Independent Wikimedia photographs retain their separate credits.

sources.title: Project owner: Philippine flag at the southern forecourt, 1 October 2026
sources.note: Explicit request for a recognizable Philippine flag on the previously relocated mapped pole. Flag identity is owner-supplied; location remains the existing atlas annotation correction. The pole-and-flag marker is illustrative, not a measurement or trace from Google imagery.
